title: Why use multiple heads?
source_copy: Desktop copy, 26-slide revision inspected on October 10, 2026 (Asia/Shanghai)
adaptation: Retain the sentence and three relation questions; move the query from gave to food so every shown position is causally available. All weights are invented.

steps.label: One head forms one weighting of the available positions for this query. Its row sums to one.
Other heads can form different context mixtures for the same query position, in parallel.
